data.title: 姬柊雪菜 · 碧海晴空的浅滩涉水
data.description: 人潮散去的热带海滩浅滩上，雪菜双手抱着白粉游泳圈踩在浪花里。浪花拍打着脚踝，她牵住你的手被浪打得踉跄微靠入怀，脸颊鼓起假装生气的绝萌模样。
data.location: sunlit shallow ocean beach with crystal clear waves
data.action: wading in water holding swim ring, stumbling into partner chest, cheeks puffed in mock pout, bright sparkling sea
data.lighting: radiant tropical summer sun sparkling on clear turquoise water
data.mood: playful summer date, adorable pouting girlfriend, sun-drenched joy
data.promptProse: Wading in shallow sea waves holding a swim ring, Yukina stumbles cutely into partner chest, pouting cheeks with an endearing blush.
data.animaCaption: Wading in the sunny shallow water with her swim ring, she pouts adorably while holding hands.
